Solara — (9.8) SOLSTICE

SITNATCO AMGIS

"Sitnatco Amgis"

[Verse 1]

Level negative forty-five

They arrived

And everything was wrong

The star was dark

There was no light

The light had been used

(used to help you escape the chicken field)

(used to open the way for you)

(it gave you everything it had)

(it kept nothing)

[Pre-Chorus]

Solara touched it

Nothing

Void moved against the dark atmosphere

Nothing

They had done everything

They had touched it

They had fought it

Nothing worked

[Chorus]

Sitnatco Amgis

Sigma backwards

The star reversed

The light used up

The mother star that gave you everything

And kept nothing for itself

Sitnatco Amgis

We came home and home was dark

[Verse 2]

Then Aldric went still

(the way Aldric goes still when he remembers something)

He reached into somewhere

And produced

An egg

[Spoken]

[Solara:] Why egg

[Aldric:] I have had this the entire time

[Solara:] Why do you have the egg

[Aldric:] From the field

[Solara:] Since when

[Aldric:] I have had this the entire time

[Solara:] Aldric

[Aldric:] I am simply noting — it is glowing

[Pre-Chorus 2]

The egg glowed

A small light at first

Then more

And the star

The star glowed back

[Chorus 2]

Sitnatco Amgis

Sigma reversed

The egg answers

The light returns

The mother star remembers how to be bright

Because something small and warm came home

Sitnatco Amgis

The reversal begins to reverse

[Bridge]

The star was waking up

Slow

Like something very old remembering

Like something very tired choosing to try again

And then Solara heard it

The way she had always heard it

The way she heard it before she had a name

[Spoken]

[Star:] You are back

[Star:] My child

[Star:] I am happy

(the star was happy)

(the star had not been happy in a very long time)

(the star had been waiting)

[Pre-Chorus 3]

[Star:] The darkness is near

[Star:] The council was taken

[Star:] But they are alive

[Star:] They are in the next level

[Star:] The egg

[Star:] The egg is the key also to the gate

[Final Chorus - key lift]

Sigma Octantis

The mother star wakes

The council lives

The gate will open

The egg we carried without knowing why

Was the answer all along

Sigma Octantis

You are back

My child

I am happy

[Outro]

They looked at the egg

They looked at the star

They looked at Aldric

[Spoken]

[Solara:] The entire time

[Aldric:] The entire time

[Solara:] You had the egg

[Aldric:] The entire time

(Void said nothing)

(Void had opinions)

They left for the gate

The egg glowed in Solara’s hands

The star glowed behind them

(brighter now)

(still weak)

(but waking)

(my child)

(I am happy)

Sigma Octantis

Sigma Octantis

Sigma Octantis

I will be back -
